summary: Iter28 — Frontend-only test of /admin/settings searchable toolbar + 'NOUVEAU' bubbles. ALL acceptance criteria PASSED. (1) Login flow with dev_otp exposure: POST /api/auth/login returns {needs_otp:true, session_token, dev_otp:'123456', message:'Plateforme Interne : code OTP affiché directement sur la page.'} and POST /api/auth/verify-otp with that code returns access_token — verified 2x with fresh sessions. (2) /admin/settings renders with [data-testid=admin-settings-page]. (3) Sticky toolbar [data-testid=settings-toolbar] is present with class containing 'sticky top-0 z-30 ... bg-slate-50/95 backdrop-blur'. (4) 28 sections registered in [data-testid=settings-jump-select] (header option + 27 section titles, alphabetically sorted). (5) Search input [data-testid=settings-search-input] filters dynamically: typing 'PawaPay' → exactly 1 visible section with [data-settings-anchor], and [data-testid=settings-filter-info] shows '1 paramètre(s) trouvé(s) pour « PawaPay »' as required. (6) [data-testid=settings-search-clear] clears the input and restores all sections. (7) Selecting 'Paiement — PawaPay (Mobile Money)' in the jump-select scrolls the inner scroll container ('flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 h-screen overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden') from scrollTop=0 to 9501px and brings the PawaPay anchor into viewport (top=130, bottom=404, vh=1080). (8) NEW bubbles: after clearing localStorage 'sawali_settings_first_seen_v1' and reloading, exactly 7 [data-testid^=new-badge-] elements rendered with text '• NOUVEAU' on: Jauge d'occupation, Diagnostic des données orphelines, Cohérence multi-utilisateurs, Diagnostic visibilité par utilisateur, Compteur de visites, Bandeau d'incident, Santé applicative — Alertes & rapports. The 8th NEW_SECTIONS entry 'Authentification — OTP par domaine' (2026-04-26) is past the 14-day NEW_WINDOW (now=2026-05-10, 14d cutoff = 2026-04-26 inclusive boundary; date diff is 14.0 → falsy); not a bug, expected behavior of isStillNew(). The same 7 are also flagged with '🆕 ' prefix in the dropdown options (header shows '(7 nouveaux)'). (9) Save: clicking 'Enregistrer les paramètres' triggered PUT /admin/settings, the success toast 'Paramètres enregistrés' appeared (visible green toast top-right in screenshot) — no regressions on save flow. No console errors on the settings page (only an unrelated React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from PortalLayout — pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration).

issues: Minor: 'Authentification — OTP par domaine' (added 2026-04-26) sits exactly at the 14-day NEW_WINDOW_DAYS boundary on the test date (2026-05-10), so its NEW bubble does not appear. If E1 wants it shown for one more iteration, either bump its addedAt to 2026-04-27+ or change the comparison '> NEW_WINDOW_DAYS' to '>= NEW_WINDOW_DAYS' in isStillNew().

critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettings.jsx L54-97 (Filterable): correctly uses IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.4 to mark sections seen on first visit. The fade window (SEEN_FADE_DAYS=3) gracefully retires bubbles after 3 days post-first-view per browser. Good UX.
AdminSettings.jsx L101-104 (SettingsToolbar): titles sorted with localeCompare — handles French accents correctly. matchCount uses case-insensitive includes — adequate for short titles.

AdminSettings.jsx L210-213 (filterCtxValue useMemo): dependency array is [search, registry, seenMap] — register/unregister/setSearch/markSeen are referentially unstable each render but are intentionally excluded. This is fine because Filterable's useEffect depends only on [title, anchorId], and ctx changing identity won't re-fire registration. Acceptable.

Filterable returns null when search doesn't match (L80) — this UNREGISTERS the section from the Provider's registry via the useEffect cleanup. Result: while typing 'PawaPay' the jump-select dropdown shrinks from 28 → 2 options. This is a subtle UX side-effect: the dropdown becomes useless during a search. Consider keeping registration even when filtered out, by moving the early-return AFTER the register effect or by registering inside a useLayoutEffect that doesn't depend on visibility. Non-blocking.
L19-28 NEW_SECTIONS map is hardcoded with absolute dates — works fine but means every new section requires an explicit code edit. Acceptable for this iter; consider moving to a JSON config later.
Filterable L84 uses scroll-mt-32 (8rem offset) for sticky toolbar header — appropriate for the ~80px sticky toolbar height.
